'''Divv''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who had acquired information on [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] spy network located on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. He arranged to sell the information to one of Jabba's rivals, an [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] named [[Yin Vocta]]. Although Divv's role in regards to Jabba's organization was never specified, he did know that one of Jabba's taste testers had been recently poisoned. Based upon a comment Yin Vocta had made, it was implied that Yin had attempted the poisoning.

Divv was nervous during the meet but Yin displayed nothing but pleasant courtesy towards him. After handing the [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] of names over, Yin immediately ordered his two bodyguards, the [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Haelon Tice]] and the shadowy [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|findsman]] [[R'Kayza]], to kill everyone on the list. Divv was surprised at how quickly the execution order had been delivered but Yin responded with a humorous quip.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Divv was created by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] as part of a short story ''[[Valuable Commodities]]'' for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].
